title: DNS disruption affected developer services
summary: A DNS failure followed a database migration at one site. Temporary DNS capacity restored the infrastructure; code search recovered later.
impact: Copilot completions degraded for 4% of users. A quarter of Actions workflow users saw delays over five minutes. Code search failed for about four hours.
action: The published report does not specify a customer action.

events.label: Temporary DNS deployed
events.detail: The team began its revised mitigation.
